quotes.title: HAT-P-6
quotes.card: HAT-P-6, also named Sterrennacht is a star in the constellation Andromeda, located approximately 895 light years or 274 parsecs away from the Earth.
quotes.introduction: It is an F-type star, implying that it is hotter and more massive than the Sun.
